mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ods_game_record_one_net ogron INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (ogron.user_id = dui.user_id) WHERE ogron.dates = #{dates}

SELECT ogron.id source_id, ogron.dates, ogron.pkg_game_id, opgon.game_code, ogron.pkg_id, ogron.game_id, dui.user_id, dui.last_version `version`, dui.pkg, dui.country, ogron.s_id, ogron.played_time, ogron.start_time, ogron.end_time, ogron.game_result, ogron.reward_source, ogron.reward_account_type, ogron.reward, ogron.expend, ogron.expend_account_type, ogron.create_time, ogron.end_time FROM ods_game_record_one_net ogron INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = ogron.user_id) LEFT JOIN ods_pkg_game_one_net opgon on (opgon.id = ogron.pkg_game_id) where ogron.dates = #{dates} limit #{startRows}, #{rows}

SELECT dugro.id, ogron.id source_id, ogron.dates, ogron.pkg_game_id, opgon.game_code, ogron.pkg_id, ogron.game_id, dui.user_id, dui.last_version `version`, dui.pkg, dui.country, ogron.s_id, ogron.played_time, ogron.start_time, ogron.end_time, ogron.game_result, ogron.reward_source, ogron.reward_account_type, ogron.reward, ogron.expend, ogron.expend_account_type, ogron.create_time, ogron.end_time FROM ods_game_record_one_net ogron INNER JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = ogron.user_id) LEFT JOIN ods_pkg_game_one_net opgon on (opgon.id = ogron.pkg_game_id) LEFT JOIN dwd_user_game_record_oeta dugro on (dugro.source_id = ogron.id) where ogron.id = #{sourceId}
